description: The only message format agents exchange. Agents never exchange free-form execution instructions; anything outside this envelope, or with an unknown intent type or unknown parameter, must be rejected by the receiver. This schema is authoritative; the Kotlin and Python definitions in this directory must match it.

agent_id.description: Id of the agent that created this envelope, e.g. phone-agent, watch-agent, pc-agent, earphone-agent, cloud-orchestrator.

confirmation_tier.description: 1 = may run directly (chat, read-only query, voice readout). 2 = confirm once on the executing device (open app, alarm, timer, note, web search). 3 = confirm on the primary device UI (calendar event, file write, cross-device sensitive action). The tier is set by the receiver's policy, never by the sender's free text.

device_id.description: Id of the device that created this envelope (not a personal identifier).

intent_type.description: The first seven types come from the phone MVP. HANDOFF_TASK moves an existing task to another device. VOICE_COMMAND carries a transcribed voice request; the receiving agent must still turn it into one of the other intent types and confirm it before executing.

params.description: Validated parameters for this intent type only. Unknown parameter keys must be rejected. Per-type required keys are defined in protocol/envelope.py and in the phone MVP IntentValidator; examples: OPEN_APP requires appName, SET_ALARM requires hour/minute, WEB_SEARCH requires query, HANDOFF_TASK requires target_device_id and original_task_id, VOICE_COMMAND requires transcript.

status.description: Task lifecycle. pending = awaiting confirmation; confirmed = user confirmed, not yet run; executing = running; completed = finished; cancelled = stopped, with no partial side effect left behind where the executor can avoid it.

target_device_id.description: Optional. Only for HANDOFF_TASK: the device the task is handed to.

task_id.description: Unique task id, stable across a cross-device handoff. The same task_id follows one task from watch to phone to PC.
